en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal city with a waterfront and a prominent church with a tall spire in the background. The foreground shows piers or docks, and several boats are visible on the water. The architecture and overall mood suggest a historical European town. Text in Swedish is printed at the bottom, along with the photographer's name and city.
